```text
## 這代表什麼

- 這台是**新晶片**機。裝任何自訂韌體前都要確認它寫明支援 UC25HQ80，見[兩種 Flash 晶片](hardware/flash-chips.md)。SLOOP 2.8.5 有支援。
- m-bootloader 在這顆晶片上測試很少，暫不安裝。這也表示 SLOOP 3 暫時不刷。
- 出廠是 015，不是 016，所以沒有 016 覆寫 preset 區的問題。不要用 M-UPGRADE 升到 016，除非確定要。

## 備份

備份檔放在本機的 `backups/`（gitignore，不進 git），異地副本用 `just fm1-backup-release <目錄>` 上傳成這個 repo 的 Release 附件。這個 repo 是 public，所以附件任何人都能下載；這是我自己的決定，映像只適用於這台機器。
```

```text
# Tasks for the notes site and for the FM-1 itself. Run `just` to list them.
#
# Device recipes follow the safety tiers in AGENTS.md:
#   read-only   fm1-find, fm1-info, fm1-backup, fm1-fetch, fm1-verify-backups, fm1-versions,
#               emu-* (the emulator never touches the unit)
#   mode switch fm1-download-mode, fm1-restart
#   write       fm1-flash, fm1-switch   (owner only; M-Flasher asks for a typed "yes")
# There is deliberately no recipe for bootloader, restore or run-ram.

m_flasher := env("M_FLASHER", "/Applications/M-Flasher.app/Contents/MacOS/M-Flasher")
m_flasher_version := "0.12.1"
sloop_version := "2.8.5"
fm1_emu_version := "0.5.1"
agtdeck_version := "0.7"
ctl_version := "1.0.3"
choralroot_tag := "v0.41"
choralroot_pkg := "choralroot-0.41.fwsc"
remote_version := "0.3.6"
jamtrack_version := "0.2.3"
polly_version := "0.6.4"
cord_version := "1.0.3"
# firmwares that speak (docs/dev/tts.md): listened to in the emulator only
speak37_version := "1.0"
spellbox_version := "0.3"
dx386_version := "2.0"
chimera_version := "0.8.0"
evilgenius_version := "0.1.4"

default:
    @just --list

# ---- docs -------------------------------------------------------------------

# Build the site in strict mode.
fm1-install-flasher: fm1-fetch
    open "downloads/M-Flasher-{{m_flasher_version}}-macos.dmg"

# Open the M-Flasher window.
fm1-gui:
    open -a M-Flasher

# Open the offline SLOOP web editor in Chrome.
sloop-editor:
    open -a "Google Chrome" "downloads/sloop-editor-{{sloop_version}}.html"

# ---- emulator (never touches the unit) ---------------------------------------

# Download fm1-emu (macOS arm64) into tools/fm1-emu/ and verify it against the release digest.
emu-fetch:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    a="fm1-emu-{{fm1_emu_version}}-macos-arm64.tar.gz"
    mkdir -p downloads tools/fm1-emu
    gh release download "v{{fm1_emu_version}}" -R joakimeriksson/fm1-emu -p "$a" -D downloads --clobber
    want=$(gh api "repos/joakimeriksson/fm1-emu/releases/tags/v{{fm1_emu_version}}" --jq ".assets[] | select(.name==\"$a\") | .digest" | sed 's/^sha256://')
    got=$(shasum -a 256 "downloads/$a" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    [ -n "$want" ] && [ "$want" = "$got" ] || { echo "FAIL $a: got $got, release says ${want:-<no digest>}" >&2; exit 1; }
    tar -xzf "downloads/$a" -C tools/fm1-emu --strip-components=1
    xattr -d com.apple.quarantine tools/fm1-emu/fm1-live tools/fm1-emu/fm1-emu 2>/dev/null || true
    tools/fm1-emu/fm1-live --version

# Download Agent Deck's package and verify its digest and build attestation.
fw-setup:
    git submodule update --init --recursive third_party/fm1-base
    git submodule update --init firmware/morse
    git submodule update --init firmware/metronome
    uv sync --locked --all-groups

# Build an app's host simulator (no toolchain needed) and run its test script.
fm1-find:
    "{{m_flasher}}" find

# Show what is on the unit (needs download mode).
fm1-info:
    "{{m_flasher}}" info

# Full-flash backup into backups/<date>-<label>/, then print its SHA-256.
fm1-backup label="backup":
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    dir="backups/$(date +%Y-%m-%d)-{{label}}"
    mkdir -p "$dir"
    "{{m_flasher}}" backup "$dir"
    shasum -a 256 "$dir"/*.bin
    echo "Record this in docs/device-log.md and keep a copy off this machine."

# Check every backup image against the SHA-256 stored in its .json.
fm1-verify-backups:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    shopt -s nullglob
    rc=0
    for bin in backups/*/*.bin; do
      want=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["sha256"])' "${bin%.bin}.json")
      got=$(shasum -a 256 "$bin" | cut -d' ' -f1)
      if [ "$want" = "$got" ]; then echo "ok   $bin"; else echo "FAIL $bin" >&2; rc=1; fi
    done
    exit $rc

# ---- device: mode switch ----------------------------------------------------

# Restart a running unit into download mode over USB MIDI (stock 015, Felucca).
fm1-download-mode:
    "{{m_flasher}}" download-mode
fm1-backup-release dir:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    name=$(basename "{{dir}}")   # accept a bare name or a path like backups/<name>/
    d="backups/$name"; tag="backup-$name"
    test -d "$d" || { echo "no such directory: $d" >&2; exit 1; }
    sums=$(cd "$d" && shasum -a 256 *.bin)
    notes=$(printf 'Full-flash backup of my own FM-1 (1 MiB), made with M-Flasher.\nDevice-specific: restore only to this unit. See docs/device-log.md.\n\nSHA-256:\n%s\n' "$sums")
    if gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      gh release upload "$tag" "$d"/*.bin "$d"/*.json --clobber
    else
      gh release create "$tag" "$d"/*.bin "$d"/*.json --title "Backup $name" --notes "$notes" --latest=false
    fi
    gh release view "$tag" --json url,assets --jq '.url, (.assets[] | "\(.name) \(.digest)")'

# ---- rhythm: RHYTHM, a rhythm trainer (firmware/rhythm, docs/dev/rhythm.md) ----
```

````text
# 安裝 M-Flasher

[M-Flasher](https://github.com/jvitkauskas/m-flasher) 是電腦端的工具：備份整顆 flash、還原、安裝 `.fwsc` 韌體、安裝或移除 m-bootloader。它直接跟晶片 ROM 內建的 USB download mode 溝通，所以韌體壞掉時也能用。目前版本見[資源地圖](../resources.md)。

它和 m-bootloader 是兩回事：

| | 裝在哪 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| M-Flasher | 電腦 | 備份、刷機、還原、救援 |
| m-bootloader | FM-1 裡的 boot 區 | 開機時的 recovery menu、從按鍵進 download mode、啟動前檢查韌體 |

## macOS

需要 macOS 11 以上，Apple silicon 與 Intel 都支援。

1. 從 [releases](https://github.com/jvitkauskas/m-flasher/releases) 或[下載頁](https://jvitkauskas.github.io/m-apps/flasher/)取得 `M-Flasher-<版本>-macos.dmg`。
2. 開啟 dmg，把 M-Flasher 拖進 Applications。
3. 第一次開啟會被 macOS 擋下，因為它沒有 Apple 簽章：到 **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**。
4. app 找到機器時會出現兩個系統對話框：
    - 要求輸入密碼。只有管理員能把 USB 裝置從 macOS 的 disk driver 手上拿走。
    - 詢問是否允許 M-Flasher 存取 removable volume（那就是 FM-1），選 **Allow**。只會問一次。

!!! note "接上後盡快開 app"
    機器進 download mode 後如果一直留給 macOS 的 disk driver，大約半分鐘後可能自己離開 download mode。

!!! warning "首次授權不能透過 SSH"
    removable volume 的詢問只會出現在螢幕上。第一次一定要在本機圖形介面完成，之後 CLI 才能順利用。

### 驗證下載檔

Release 頁面每個 asset 都有 SHA-256 digest。下載後比對：

```sh
shasum -a 256 M-Flasher-0.12.1-macos.dmg
gh api repos/jvitkauskas/m-flasher/releases/latest \
  --jq '.assets[] | select(.name | test("macos")) | "\(.name) \(.digest)"'
```
````

```python
"""What this computer is missing for the FM-1 work: offline, fast, read-only.

Run at the start of every agent session (the SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json)
and by `just doctor`. It never touches the unit, the network or any file; it only looks.

  --brief   print nothing when everything is in place (for the hook)

The fix for almost everything it reports is `just setup` (downloads only, digest-checked).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import platform
import re
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
JUSTFILE = ROOT / "Justfile"
DEVICE_LOG = ROOT / "docs" / "device-log.md"


def just_var(name: str) -> str | None:
    m = re.search(rf'^{name}\s*:=\s*(?:env\("[^"]+",\s*)?"([^"]+)"', JUSTFILE.read_text(), re.M)
    return m.group(1) if m else None


def main() -> int:
    brief = "--brief" in sys.argv
    machine = platform.machine()
    is_mac = sys.platform == "darwin"
    missing: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (what, fix)
    notes: list[str] = []

    # Repo-side pieces that `just setup` brings back.
    for sub in ("third_party/fm1-base", "firmware/morse", "firmware/metronome"):
        if not (ROOT / sub / ".git").exists():
            missing.append((f"submodule {sub} not checked out", "just setup"))
    if not (ROOT / ".venv").is_dir():
        missing.append(("Python environment (.venv)", "just setup"))

    sloop = just_var("sloop_version")
    mfv = just_var("m_flasher_version")
    if sloop and not (ROOT / f"downloads/sloop-{sloop}.fwsc").exists():
        missing.append((f"downloads/sloop-{sloop}.fwsc", "just setup"))

    # M-Flasher: the only way to back up or switch with download mode. GUI-only first run.
    m_flasher = os.environ.get("M_FLASHER") or just_var("m_flasher") or ""
    if is_mac and not Path(m_flasher).exists():
        missing.append((f"M-Flasher app ({m_flasher})",
                        f"owner: `just fm1-install-flasher` (opens the {mfv} dmg), drag to Applications, "
                        "open it once in the GUI (Open Anyway, password, Allow removable volume)"))

    # Emulator: no macOS x86_64 build upstream.
    emu = ROOT / "tools/fm1-emu/fm1-live"
    if not emu.exists():
        if is_mac and machine == "x86_64":
            notes.append("fm1-emu has no macOS x86_64 build: emu-* recipes do not work on this Intel Mac. "
                         "Use the web emulator (fw-preview / fw-web) or an Apple silicon machine.")
        else:
            missing.append(("fm1-emu (tools/fm1-emu/)", "just setup"))

    # Backups: full-flash images and progress JSON are git-ignored and machine-local.
    bins = sorted((ROOT / "backups").glob("*/*.bin"))
    progress = sorted((ROOT / "backups/progress").glob("*.json"))
    if not bins:
        missing.append(("no full-flash backup on this computer (backups/*/*.bin)",
                        "just setup (pulls the public release backups); a fresh one needs M-Flasher: just fm1-backup LABEL"))
    # Backups the device log lists that are neither here nor in a release.
    only_elsewhere = []
    if DEVICE_LOG.exists():
        for line in DEVICE_LOG.read_text().splitlines():
            if line.startswith("| 20") and "尚未上傳" in line:
                m = re.search(r"`(backups/[^`]+?\.bin)`", line)
                if m and not (ROOT / m.group(1)).exists():
                    only_elsewhere.append(m.group(1))
    if only_elsewhere:
        notes.append(f"{len(only_elsewhere)} backups in docs/device-log.md were never uploaded and are not here "
                     f"(only on the old computer), newest: {only_elsewhere[-1]}")

    # Firmware development, informational.
    if is_mac and shutil.which("brew") and not any(Path(p).exists() for p in
                                                  ("/opt/homebrew/opt/libraqm", "/usr/local/opt/libraqm")):
        notes.append("libraqm not installed (just fw-test needs it): brew install libraqm")
    if not shutil.which("docker"):
        notes.append("docker not found (just fw-build needs it)")
    if not shutil.which("gh"):
        missing.append(("gh CLI", "brew install gh && gh auth login"))

    if brief and not missing:
        return 0

    head = f"[fm1 doctor] {platform.node()} ({sys.platform} {machine})"
    if not missing:
        print(f"{head}: everything in place; {len(bins)} full-flash backups, {len(progress)} progress files.")
    else:
        print(f"{head}: this computer is not set up for the FM-1 yet (new machine or fresh clone).")
        for what, fix in missing:
            print(f"  missing: {what}\n           fix: {fix}")
        print(f"  have: {len(bins)} full-flash backups, {len(progress)} progress files in backups/")
        print("  Agents: run `just setup` now (downloads only, digest-checked; no device access), "
              "then `just doctor`. Do not operate the unit until M-Flasher works and a fresh backup exists.")
    for n in notes:
        print(f"  note: {n}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

Add doctor, setup, fm1-backup-pull recipes

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("Justfile"); s=p.read_text()
old="default:\n    @just --list\n\n"
new=old+'''# ---- this computer ------------------------------------------------------------

# What this computer is missing (offline, read-only; the SessionStart hook runs it too).
doctor:
    @python3 scripts/doctor.py

# New computer or fresh clone: submodules, Python env, M-Flasher + SLOOP downloads, fm1-emu where it
# exists, the public release backups. Downloads only, digest-checked; never touches the unit.
setup:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    git submodule update --init --recursive
    uv sync --locked --all-groups
    just fm1-fetch
    if [ "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" = "Darwin-arm64" ]; then just emu-fetch; else echo "skip emu-fetch: fm1-emu has no build for $(uname -s) $(uname -m) here"; fi
    just fm1-backup-pull
    mkdir -p backups/progress
    echo
    python3 scripts/doctor.py

# Download every backup-* GitHub Release (public full-flash backups) into backups/<name>/, digest-checked.
# Read-only: skips a folder that already has its .bin.
fm1-backup-pull:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    for tag in $(gh release list -L 200 --json tagName --jq '.[].tagName | select(startswith("backup-"))'); do
      d="backups/${tag#backup-}"
      if ls "$d"/*.bin >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "have $d"; continue; fi
      mkdir -p "$d"
      gh release download "$tag" -D "$d" --clobber
      gh release view "$tag" --json assets --jq '.assets[] | "\\(.name) \\(.digest)"' | while read -r name digest; do
        got=$(shasum -a 256 "$d/$name" | cut -d' ' -f1)
        [ "sha256:$got" = "$digest" ] || { echo "FAIL $d/$name: got $got, release says $digest" >&2; exit 1; }
      done
      echo "ok   $d"
    done
    just fm1-verify-backups

'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new); p.write_text(s)
PY
just --list 2>&1 | grep -E "doctor|setup|backup-pull"
```

````markdown
# 換電腦

裝置相關的東西幾乎都不在 git 裡：`backups/`、`downloads/`、`tools/`、`.venv`、submodule，還有裝在 `/Applications` 的 M-Flasher。新 clone 的 repo 這些全都沒有。2026-11-28 換到新的 Intel Mac 時，就是在要刷 SLOOP 時才發現這件事。

## 怎麼發現少了什麼

```sh
just doctor
```

它不連網、不碰機器，只檢查這台電腦，列出少了什麼、怎麼補。Claude Code 每次開 session 都會透過 `.claude/settings.json` 的 SessionStart hook 自動執行 `scripts/doctor.py --brief`：全部都在就不印東西，少了東西就把清單放進 agent 的 context。其他 agent 照 `AGENTS.md` 的規定，開工前自己跑 `just doctor`。

## 自動補齊

```sh
just setup
```

只下載，每個檔案都比對 release 的 SHA-256 digest，不碰機器。它會做這些事：

| 步驟 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| `git submodule update --init --recursive` | `third_party/fm1-base`、`firmware/morse`、`firmware/metronome` |
| `uv sync` | Python 環境（`morse-backup` 這類 recipe 要用） |
| `just fm1-fetch` | M-Flasher 的 dmg、SLOOP package 和 SLOOP 編輯器 |
| `just emu-fetch` | 只在 Apple silicon Mac 上跑，原因見下面 |
| `just fm1-backup-pull` | 把所有 `backup-*` GitHub Release 下載到 `backups/<名稱>/`，逐檔比對 digest，最後跑 `fm1-verify-backups` |

Agent 看到 doctor 回報有缺東西，會直接跑 `just setup`，不用先問。

## 只有本人能做的

- **M-Flasher**：`just fm1-install-flasher` 會打開 dmg，把 app 拖進 Applications，然後在 GUI 開一次，完成第一次授權（見[安裝 M-Flasher](install-m-flasher.md)）。這一步不能透過 SSH 做。dmg 是 universal binary，Intel 和 Apple silicon 都能用 `[實機]`（2026-11-28 用 `file` 確認過）。
- `brew install libraqm`（`just fw-test` 需要）、Docker（`just fw-build` 需要）、`gh auth login`。

## 備份只有一部分跟著走

- 上傳過 GitHub Release 的備份，`just setup` 會抓下來。`docs/device-log.md` 裡標著「尚未上傳」的備份，只存在當初做備份的那台電腦上。doctor 會列出有幾份。
- 換電腦後要刷韌體，**先在新電腦上重新做一份 `just fm1-backup`**。Release 上的備份都比機器現在的狀態舊。
- 存在機器裡的進度（Morse、THEORY、METRONOME）可以用 `just morse-backup` / `theory-backup` / `metro-backup` 存成 JSON。這幾個只需要 `uv` 和 USB 線，不需要 M-Flasher。存好的檔案在 `backups/progress/`，建議另外複製一份到別的地方。

## Intel Mac 跑不了 fm1-emu

fm1-emu 0.5.1 只出 macOS arm64、Linux 和 Windows 版，沒有 macOS x86_64 版 `[上游]`（[releases](https://github.com/joakimeriksson/fm1-emu/releases)），Intel 上的 Rosetta 也跑不了 arm64。在 Intel Mac 上 `emu-*` recipe 都不能用。替代方式：用網頁版模擬器（`just fw-preview`），或改在 Apple silicon 的電腦上跑。自己 build 的韌體在實刷前要在兩種晶片的模擬器上各跑一次，這條規則不變；如果做不到，要在回報裡寫清楚，不能直接略過。
````

```bash
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    f="{{file}}"; test -f "$f" || { echo "no such file: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    name=$(basename "$f" .json); tag="progress-$name"
```
